shared_elements: single-plane figures set against a plain undecorated rock surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry animal figures rendered in profile on an otherwise blank stone field, which is about as generic as iconographic overlap gets. A shows one large, isolated, anatomically modelled quadruped filling the whole panel, whereas B is a scattered multi-figure scene of schematic silhouette boats with crew strokes, spear-bearing stick humans and small emblem-like signs \u2014 different subject matter, different narrative density and different drawing conventions.
